title: A Choir for the Bell
author: Isandro Lockridge
blurb: Wren Joubert, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
